action.description: Source sensor action, such as allowed/blocked. Does not prove maliciousness or remediation.

capture-file.description: Explicit native or collector-supplied packet capture reference; never opened.

capture-sha256.description: Producer-supplied SHA-256 of the referenced capture, not the imported log/export.

capture-url.description: Explicit source capture/investigation reference; never fetched.

community-id.description: Source-provided Community ID. Seed/version and capture context must agree before treating two records as the same flow.

community-id-raw.description: Original Community ID value, including unsupported or malformed values retained without normalization.

event-time.description: Normalized source observation time, with a known offset and no sub-microsecond rounding.

flow-end.description: Explicit source flow end time. Never invented from log write time or a rounded duration.

flow-id.description: Reported Suricata unsigned 64-bit flow_id; scoped to its sensor/capture/run.

flow-start.description: Explicit connection/flow start time when the source defines it.

generator-id.description: Reported Suricata alert generator ID, validated as an unsigned integer.

interface.description: Reported capture interface, such as native EVE in_iface.

log-type.description: Zeek stream/path name or Suricata EVE event_type.

message.description: Zeek notice/signature message or other explicit source message.

notice-type.description: Zeek notice enum/type, distinct from a Suricata SID.

packet-number.description: Native Suricata pcap_cnt, the packet number within the capture; not a log row count.

raw-record.description: Complete normalized source JSON; for Zeek TSV, original line/escaped columns, type/marker headers and decoded values. Original bytes remain authoritative when attached.

record-index.description: One-based source record ordinal excluding Zeek headers and blank JSONL lines.

review-status.description: Imported observations and sensor matches start as unreviewed, not confirmed malicious.

sensor.description: Explicit producer/collector sensor identity; not inferred from an endpoint IP.

severity.description: Source severity value; not a MISP confidence or analyst verdict.

signature.description: Reported Suricata signature/message text; not an analyst-confirmed verdict.

signature-id.description: Reported Suricata numeric SID or symbolic Zeek signature identifier; not rule text.

signature-revision.description: Reported Suricata alert revision, validated as an unsigned integer.

source-context.description: JSON of explicit collector defaults; separate context is not authenticated by the raw export hash.

source-format.description: Actual parsed encoding: json, jsonl or zeek-tsv.

source-sha256.description: SHA-256 of exact input log/export bytes, including records excluded by selection.

timestamp-raw.description: Original timestamp value as text, preserving decimal value/precision or ISO offset before normalization. Exact lexical bytes remain in the source export.

tool-version.description: Producer-supplied tool version; never inferred from the importer.

transaction-id.description: Native Suricata tx_id within its flow/capture scope.

zeek-uid.description: Reported Zeek connection UID; scoped to the sensor/capture/run, never a globally unique flow identity.

description: A sensor-reported network observation or detection with Zeek/Suricata flow identifiers, timestamps, signature and capture provenance. Keep sensor matches distinct from analyst-confirmed malicious findings.
name: network-observation
